# E0306: member not in the trait

A trait impl holds only the trait's members. Move the other methods to an inherent `impl` block of the type.

- Rule: [`traits.impl-members`](../../reference/11-traits.md#traits.impl-members)
- Reported at: the member's name.
- Tier: `core`, checked in the `items` phase

## Example

This program makes the mistake:

```stilt E0306:9
trait Shape {
  fn area(self) -> f64
}

type Circle = { radius: f64 }

impl Shape for Circle {
  fn area(self) -> f64 { 3.14 * self.radius * self.radius }
  fn perimeter(self) -> f64 { 6.28 * self.radius }
}
```

This one is fixed:

```stilt
trait Shape {
  fn area(self) -> f64
}

type Circle = { radius: f64 }

impl Shape for Circle {
  fn area(self) -> f64 { 3.14 * self.radius * self.radius }
}

impl Circle {
  fn perimeter(self) -> f64 { 6.28 * self.radius }
}
```

## What the compiler prints

`stilt check` on [`E0306_method_not_in_the_trait.lt`](../../tests/diagnostics/E0306_method_not_in_the_trait.lt):

```text
── MEMBER NOT IN THE TRAIT ─────── E0306_method_not_in_the_trait.lt:9:6  [E0306]

`perimeter` is not a member of `Shape`:

  9 │   fn perimeter(self) -> f64 { 6.28 * self.radius }
    │      ^^^^^^^^^

A trait impl holds only the trait's members. Move the other methods to an
inherent `impl` block of the type.
```
